race.description: Hyland Race Colours Show County Qlty (G3)
race.comment: DISNECK (2) saves his best for this track and trip and returns from a lengthy spell. Defeated a good line up when taking out the G3 Standish Hcp over 1200m at Flemington last January. Looked to be trucking in both trials and has genuine claims. CAMPIONE D'ITALIA (8) ATC Sires' winner taking on the older horses first up. Adept in all conditions and looked to have plenty up the sleeve in both trials against the older horses. Will be strong late. ENRICHED (3) good fresh entire who saves his best for this track and trip. Tongue-tie comes off and will tag the speed from the good draw. Both trials had merit and must be kept safe. AVIATRESS (4) two runs back have only been fair and expect to see a more positive ride today. Excellent run when fourth to DISNECK in the Standish last January. One for the exotics. SOOTHSAYER (9) has residual fitness on his side and kept up to the mark with a 1000m trial. Well drawn and can take a hand in the finish.
